stem: The author included the section “How High Can We Go?” most likely to emphasize that —

options.label: A
options.text: the designs commonly used in today’s tall buildings are complex

options.label: B
options.text: the ability to construct tall buildings has increased greatly over time

options.label: C
options.text: the need for tall buildings has remained constant over time

options.label: D
options.text: new technology and materials have lowered the cost of building tall buildings
